analysis.summary: In FY 2024-25, Vikram Thermo (India) Limited reported revenue from continuing operations of Rs. 12,623.06 lakhs, up from Rs. 10,127.26 lakhs in FY 2023-24. Overall Profit After Tax stood at Rs. 809.85 lakhs, reflecting the impact of the demerger of its Aromatic Chemicals (Diphenyl Oxide) business unit into Vikram Aroma Limited.

guidance.claim: The company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth by developing high-margin, research-driven products for domestic and international markets.
guidance.quote: With a focus on building a sustainable and scalable business model, the Company remains committed to driving profitable revenue growth through the development and commercialization of high-margin, research-driven products tailored to the specific needs of customers in both domestic and international markets.

guidance.claim: The company intends to venture into new markets with favorable competition and work on new and complex products in fiscal 2024.
guidance.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's growth has been supported by its Pan-India presence and expanding global footprint.
demand_outlook.quote: Our extensive PAN-India presence, along with a steadily expanding global footprint, has significantly contributed to the Company's growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Vikram Thermo stated that its nationwide presence and expanding global footprint in newer territories have yielded rich dividends.
demand_outlook.quote: The PAN - INDIA presence with global footprints expanding to newer territories have yielded rich dividends to your company.

demand_outlook.claim: The company faced global uncertainties and challenges stemming from the aftershocks of the COVID-19 pandemic during the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite the global uncertainties and unprecedented challenges that came in our way through the aftershocks of covid-19 pandemic, we remained resilient and steadfast in our commitment to deliver value to all our stakeholders.

capex_expansion.claim: Vikram Thermo incurred no capital expenditure on Research and Development during the financial year.
The Board approved a demerger scheme to transfer the company's Aromatic Chemical Business into Vikram Aroma Limited.
capex_expansion.quote: The company has announced through its Board Meeting held on17th September, 2022 the Approval of the Scheme of Arrangement and demerger whereby Aromatic Chemical Business (hereinafter referred to as 'Demerged Business' or Unit II) of M/s Vikram Thermo (India) Limited will be demerged into M/s Vikram Aroma Limited.

margins_costs.claim: Total income from continuing operations increased to Rs. 12,623.06 lakhs in FY 2024-25 from Rs. 10,127.26 lakhs in FY 2023-24.
margins_costs.quote: Total Income from continuing operation increased to Rs. 12623.06 Lakhs in comparison to Rs. 10127.26 Lakhs of Previous Financial Year 2023-24.

margins_costs.claim: The company is focusing on building a sustainable business model centered on profitable revenue growth and launching high-margin research-based products.
margins_costs.quote: The company's focus is to build a sustainable business model with a focus on profitable revenue growth and launch of research based high margin products suiting to the specific needs of customers in domestic as well as overseas markets.

margins_costs.claim: Operating income grew by 20.95% to Rs. 112.89 crores while profit after tax increased 94.59% to Rs. 16.91 crores in FY 2023.
margins_costs.quote: Our operating income grew to Rs. 112.89 crores, a growth of 20.95% as compared to the previous FY 2022, Our profits after tax increased by 94.59% from Rs. 8.69 crores, in FY 2022 to Rs. 16.91 crores in FY 2023.

margins_costs.claim: Total income rose to Rs. 11,289.13 Lakhs in FY 2022-23 compared to Rs. 9,333.17 Lakhs in FY 2021-22.
margins_costs.quote: Total Income increased to Rs. 11289.13 Lakhs in comparison to Rs. 9333.17 Lakhs of Previous Financial Year 2021-22.

margins_costs.claim: Profit before tax increased to Rs. 2,303.50 Lakhs in FY 2022-23 from Rs. 1,176.54 Lakhs in the previous financial year.
margins_costs.quote: PBT increased to Rs. 2303.50 Lakhs in comparison to Rs. 1176.54 Lakhs of Previous Financial Year 2021-22.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a 10% dividend on equity shares amounting to Rs. 1 per share for FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 10% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 1 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The recommended dividend payout will lead to a total cash outflow of Rs. 3,13,57,850.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend payout will result in total outflow of Rs. 3,13,57,850/- (Previous Year Rs. 2,35,18,388/-).

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not transfer any profits to reserves for FY 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has not transferred any amount to the reserves from the profit for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 7.5% on equity shares, amounting to Rs. 0.75 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Board of Directors are pleased to recommend payment of Dividend at 7.5% on equity shares of Rs. 10/- each, amounting to Rs. 0.75 per share on paid up equity capital of the company to those shareholders whose names appear on the Register of Member on Record date.

capital_allocation.claim: The company transferred Rs. 30,00,000 to General Reserves during the financial year 2023-24.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has transferred Rs. 30,00,000/- to General Reserves during the financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The company transferred Rs. 30,00,000 to General Reserves during FY 2022-23.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has transferred Rs. 30,00,000/- to General Reserves during the financial year 2022-23.

capital_allocation.claim: The company allotted 2,50,86,280 bonus shares of Rs. 10 each on May 14, 2022.
capital_allocation.quote: The company has made allotment of 25086280 bonus shares of Rs.10 each in the Board Meeting held on 14th May, 2022.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's risk framework involves identifying internal and external risks and preparing for extreme events like calamities.
risks_headwinds.quote: The process involves identifying both external and internal risks and the readiness to respond to extreme risks like calamities and disasters.

risks_headwinds.claim: Vikram Thermo has implemented a Risk Management Policy to identify risks that may threaten the company's existence.
risks_headwinds.quote: Your Company has developed and implemented a Risk Management Policy which includes identification of elements of risk, if any, which in the opinion of the Board, may threaten the existence of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: Risks are continuously monitored across operations, strategy, compliance, financial reporting, IT systems, and cyber security.
risks_headwinds.quote: Risks are being continuously identified in relation to business strategy, business continuity/contingency plans, operations and transactions, statutory / legal compliance, financial reporting, information technology system, cyber security and overall internal control framework.

management_commitments.claim: The company remains committed to ongoing investment in R&D, adopting new technologies, and enhancing its product offerings.
management_commitments.quote: As we move forward, the Company remains steadfast in its commitment to consistent investment in R&D, the adoption of emerging technologies, and the continuous enhancement of its product portfolio to meet the dynamic demands of the market.

management_commitments.claim: Vikram Thermo remains committed to consistently investing in R&D, exploring emerging technologies, and enhancing its product portfolio.
management_commitments.quote: The company remains committed to consistently investing in R&D, exploring emerging technologies and enhancing its product portfolio to meet the evolving needs of the market.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company will continue its transformation journey in fiscal 2024 by entering favorable markets and focusing on new, complex products.
management_commitments.quote: Way ahead as we enter fiscal 2024, we will continue on our journey of transformation by venturing into new markets where competition is favourable to the company and working on products that are new and complex.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
